if I trigger manually it starts now? ok, that was my first try and I screwed up, develop is the default yeah you gotta set the branch name in ref today I shouldn't work I think I'm screwing up after another screwup sounds like a normal wednesday 😂 nah, normally I'm more or less reasonable Today I wasted not only my time but many others' we don’t backfill sync payload envelopes yet, so we only have data up until the last time we checkpoint synced sorry ur having a bad day, hope it gets better 🫂 do you know if you checkpoint synced in the last couple of days? according to logs it looks like 6 days ago was the last checkpoint sync beautiful! thanks, do not restart your nodes for a while 🙂 although I think Lodestar can serve and they have not restarted <@412614104222531604> why there's no link in the last build I triggered? ah you can't read the message 🙂 we should serve those, what's the state you are trying to sync from, can try sync a lodestar node from there too https://github.com/ethpandaops/eth-client-docker-image-builder/actions/runs/27717066219 just look for all the actions here if you get no link but the link should always come up unless you used a wrong branch name reference Hmm weird. Anyways we have advanced a little on the syncing problems but are hitting other bugs. I rather keep the nodes not working for now instead of checkpoint syncing them. We now can get close to head but fail to sync columns correctly over RPC
